<thought>Using the most intense ion at m/z 134.10955 from the ESI‑MS spectrum, the neutral monoisotopic mass matches the formula C₁₀H₁₄ (exact mass 134.10955 Da). This gives an integer DBE (4) and fits the observed isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C10H14.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14</final_answer>
